title: DC-area forecast: Warming trend underway. Rain-free until chance of Thursday storms.
contentHtml:
Always a human at the helm: Updated around-the-clock by Capital Weather meteorologists.

Happening now: Warm and pleasant this evening with temperatures dipping through the 80s into sunset, then the 70s by 8 p.m. or so.

What's next? Our dry, mostly sunny stretch continues through Wednesday as highs climb toward 90 and humidity creeps up. Thursday brings the next real chance of showers and storms.

Forecast in detail

Tonight: Skies stay mostly clear with mainly calm winds. Lows range from 60 to 67. Confidence: High

Tomorrow (Wednesday): Sunny and a bit hotter in spots, with highs in the mid-80s to around 90. Humidity still isn't too bad (dew points near 60) as breezes pick up from the south and southwest during the day, gusting near 20 mph. Confidence: High

Hourly Forecast | Pollen, Air & UV

Tomorrow night: Mostly clear but muggier. Lows dip to the upper 60s to near 70. Breezes from the southwest may still gust near 20 mph. Confidence: High

❤️ How to support Capital Weather

Help sustain an independent Capital Weather by becoming a free or paid supporter. Learn more at capitalweather.com/support-us

A look ahead

Looking muggy Thursday with highs in the mid-80s to low 90s, feeling a bit hotter than that due to high humidity (dew points rising to near 70). An approaching cold front brings some shower and storm potential, especially midafternoon into the night. Confidence: Low-Medium

A bit of relief Friday, with increasing sunshine and somewhat lower humidity. Highs may only get to within a few degrees of 80. Confidence: Medium

A mix of clouds and sun this weekend with highs in the upper 70s to mid-80s. Some humidity tries to return and we could see a slight chance for showers and storms, perhaps favoring Saturday night, but stay tuned. Confidence: Medium

DC weather history for September 8

Relentless rain in 2011 triggered historic flash flooding, with extreme rainfall rates overwhelming roads, stranding motorists, and closing schools and government buildings across the region.

Today’s daily digit — 7/10: A very decent day even as our warming trend begins. Slightly more humid but still quite tolerable. | 🤚 Your call?
The digit is a somewhat subjective rating of the day’s weather, on a 0-to-10 scale.
